[size=4]Description[/size]
[size=2]As Alex is one of my favorite characters from the game, I knew I had to work extra hard to give him the makeover he deserves ! Two versions are available.
I was heavily inspired by ConcernedApe's beta portraits for Alex.

[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/work-in-progress-characters-re-imagined.126422/]You can also download it HERE, at the official ChucklefishForums[/url]﻿. 
You'll need to create an account. But it's fast and easy and you'll gain access to many mods you can't find anywhere else on the web, along with mods I haven't released on the Nexus yet ![/size]
[size=4]﻿[/size][/center][size=4]

[/size][size=3]How to Install manually:[/size]
[size=4]1[/size][size=3].[/size][size=2]Back up your "Portraits" and "Characters" files, in case you change your mind[/size]
[size=4]2[/size][size=2].Place the .xnb files from the "Portraits" folder into your own "Portraits" folder [/size]
[size=2](located here : SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits)[/size]
[size=4]3[/size][size=2].Place the .xnb files from the "Characters" folder into your own "Characters" folder [/size]
[size=2](located here : SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters)[/size]
[size=4]4[/size][size=2].Enjoy ![/size]
